cando.en.a0.u01.greet: 喺日常場合識講你好、多謝、唔該、對唔住同拜拜。
cando.en.a0.u02.sounds: 佢哋可以聽得出同模仿到英文入面主要嘅元音同輔音對比。
cando.en.a0.u01.basics: 佢哋可以用到一啲應急短語，例如打招呼、多謝人同叫人講慢啲。
cando.en.a0.u01.numbers: 佢哋可以講得出同聽得明一至十嘅數字。
cando.en.a1.u01.greet: 佢哋可以同人打招呼、回應人哋嘅問候同有禮貌咁講再見。
cando.en.a1.u01.intro-self: 佢哋可以講自己個名，同用簡單嘅句子介紹自己。
cando.en.a1.u02.langs: 佢哋可以講自己識講邊啲語言。
cando.en.a1.u02.origin: 佢哋可以講自己嚟自邊個國家，同埋問人哋都係咁。
cando.en.a1.u03.family: 佢哋可以講出親近嘅家人個名，同埋講啲簡單嘢關於佢哋。
cando.en.a1.u04.count: 佢哋可以數數、講價錢同歲數，同埋聽到數字嗰陣可以記低。
cando.en.a1.u05.clock: 佢哋可以用簡單嘅方式問時間同講時間。
cando.en.a1.u05.dates: 佢哋可以講星期幾、日期，同埋幾時有嘢發生。
cando.en.a1.u06.likes: 佢哋可以講自己鍾意同想要咩嘢食同飲品。
cando.en.a1.u07.order: 佢哋可以有禮貌咁叫嘢食同飲品，同埋叫埋單。
cando.en.a1.u08.around-town: 佢哋可以講自己住嗰個城鎮有啲咩，同埋啲嘢喺邊度。
cando.en.a1.u09.routine: 佢哋可以形容自己嘅日常生活，同埋幾密做啲嘢。
cando.en.a1.u10.jobs: 佢哋可以講自己做咩工，同埋問人哋做咩工。
cando.en.a1.u11.possessions: 佢哋可以講自己有啲咩，同埋問人哋有啲咩。
cando.en.a1.u12.describe-things: 佢哋可以講顏色同衫褲嘅名，同埋形容啲嘢係點樣嘅。
cando.en.a1.u13.ability: 佢哋可以講自己識做同唔識做啲咩，同埋提出簡單嘅要求。
cando.en.a1.u14.now: 佢哋可以形容呢一刻身邊發生緊咩事。
cando.en.a1.u15.weather: 佢哋可以用簡單嘅方式講天氣同季節。
cando.en.a1.u16.transport: 佢哋可以買飛、跟住簡單嘅指示，同埋搭公共交通工具。
cando.en.a1.u17.prices: 佢哋可以問啲嘢幾錢，同埋處理簡單嘅購物。
cando.en.a1.u18.describe-people: 佢哋可以形容人哋個樣係點，同埋佢哋嘅性格係點。
cando.en.a1.u19.hobbies: 佢哋可以講自己鍾意嘅嗜好同空閒時間活動。
cando.en.a1.u20.past: 佢哋可以用簡單嘅過去式句子講自己喺邊度同做過啲咩。
cando.en.a1.u21.tell-past: 佢哋可以用常用嘅過去式動詞講一個關於上星期嘅短故事。
cando.en.a1.u22.plans: 佢哋可以講計劃，同埋邀請人哋一齊做嘢。
cando.en.a1.u23.feelings: 佢哋可以講自己感受點樣，同埋形容簡單嘅健康問題。
cando.en.a1.u24.home: 佢哋可以形容自己屋企，同埋入面嘅房同埋嘢。
cando.en.a1.u25.compare: 佢哋可以用簡單嘅句子比較人、地方同埋嘢。
cando.en.a1.u26.connect: 佢哋可以用 "and"、"but" 同 "because" 連接簡單嘅諗法。
cando.en.a1.u27.about-me: 佢哋可以做一個簡短嘅口頭介紹：自己係邊個、做咩，同埋鍾意啲咩。
cando.en.a1.u28.show: 佢哋可以喺一次複習環節入面，將成個學習階段嘅嘢串連起嚟。
cando.en.a2.u01.interrupted: 佢哋可以講出忽然發生第二件事嗰陣,自己本來喺度做緊咩。
cando.en.a2.u01.ongoing: 佢哋可以講出過去某一刻自己喺度做緊咩。
cando.en.a2.u02.habits: 佢哋可以講返以前有而而家冇嘅習慣同狀態。
cando.en.a2.u02.then-now: 佢哋可以比較以前啲嘢係點同而家係點。
cando.en.a2.u03.experiences: 佢哋可以問同講人生經歷,唔使講幾時,仲識分 been 同 gone。
cando.en.a2.u04.duration: 佢哋可以用 for 同 since 講一樣嘢維持咗幾耐。
cando.en.a2.u04.progress: 佢哋可以講自己已經做咗咩、仲要做咩、定係啱啱做完咩。
cando.en.a2.u05.past-vs-perfect: 佢哋識揀用簡單過去式定現在完成式,睇個時間係咪完咗,仲可以講一個轉變同埋佢係點開始嘅。
cando.en.a2.u06.offers: 佢哋可以即場用 will 提出幫手或者快手應承人。
cando.en.a2.u06.predictions: 佢哋可以用 will 做簡單嘅預測,包埋簡短嘅天氣預報。
cando.en.a2.u07.arrangements: 佢哋可以用現在進行式講一個有時間嘅既定安排。
cando.en.a2.u07.plans: 佢哋可以講一個已經諗好嘅計劃,識揀用 going to 而唔用 will。
cando.en.a2.u08.conditions: 佢哋可以用 if 加現在式或者 will 講如果一個條件成立會發生咩或者將會發生咩。
cando.en.a2.u08.timing: 佢哋可以用 when 或者 as soon as 將一個未來動作同另一個連埋一齊。
cando.en.a2.u09.advice: 佢哋可以用 should 同 shouldn't 就日常問題俾簡單意見。
cando.en.a2.u10.rules: 佢哋可以用 have to、must 同 mustn't 解釋一個地方嘅規矩,講咩係必須、准許定係禁止嘅。
cando.en.a2.u11.requests: 佢哋可以用 could 有禮貌咁提出要求,同埋用 would 講自己想要咩或者問人哋想要咩。
cando.en.a2.u12.possibility: 佢哋可以用 might 或者 may 講可能會發生或者可能係真嘅嘢,而唔係話一定係咁。
cando.en.a2.u13.quantity-questions: 佢哋可以啱用 how much 同 how many 問啲嘢幾錢或者有幾多。
cando.en.a2.u13.quantity-words: 佢哋可以啱用 many、much 同 a lot of 配合可數同不可數名詞,買嘢嗰陣要求簡單嘅數量。
cando.en.a2.u14.amounts: 佢哋可以講一樣嘢係太多、唔夠定係啱啱好,仲可以用 a few 或者 a little 要求少少。
cando.en.a2.u15.equal: 佢哋可以用 as … as 同 not as … as 講兩樣嘢係咪一樣。
cando.en.a2.u15.manner: 佢哋可以用比較副詞比較一啲嘢做得幾好、幾快或者幾密。
cando.en.a2.u16.feedback: 佢哋可以用方式副詞同程度副詞講一樣嘢係點樣做嘅,同埋做得幾好定幾差。
cando.en.a2.u17.gerunds: 佢哋可以用 enjoy、like、love、hate 同 stop 加 -ing 動詞,講自己鍾意同唔鍾意嘅空閒活動。
cando.en.a2.u18.goals: 佢哋可以用「動詞 + to-不定式」講自己想要、需要、希望或者已經決定做咩。
cando.en.a2.u18.purpose: 佢哋可以用「to + 動詞」講自己做咗或者做緊一件事嘅原因。
cando.en.a2.u19.devices: 佢哋可以用 phrasal verb 例如 turn on/off 同 get up,同埋「動詞+介詞」組合例如 listen to、wait for 同 look for,解釋點樣用一件日常電器。
cando.en.a2.u20.identify: 佢哋可以用 who、which 或者 that 加一個界定細節,精準咁形容一個人、地方或者嘢。
cando.en.a2.u21.possession: 佢哋可以用 mine、yours、his、hers、ours 同 theirs 講自己同人哋有咩,而唔使重複個名詞。
cando.en.a2.u21.reflexive: 佢哋可以用 myself、yourself 同其他 -self/-selves 代名詞,講同一個人做同時又受落一個動作。
cando.en.a2.u22.opinions: 佢哋可以用 because、so 同 although 講意見,加原因、加結果同做對比。
cando.en.a2.u23.navigation: 佢哋可以用 into、through、across、along、past 同 over 呢啲表達移動嘅字,喺城市入面問路同指路。
cando.en.a2.u24.events: 佢哋可以就一件最近發生嘅事問同答詳細問題——邊個做咗咩、發生咗咩、點解——識揀岩嘅主語同賓語問句詞序。
cando.en.a2.u25.celebrations: 佢哋可以形容自己文化入面嘅一個慶祝活動,同其他慶祝比較,同埋講自己鍾意嗰度咩。
cando.en.a2.u26.review: 佢哋可以將發生咗嘅事、必須要做嘅嘢同自己鍾意做嘅嘢,一齊擺埋一個講述入面。
cando.en.a2.u27.my-year: 佢哋可以用口講同用文字簡短講述自己嘅一年:發生咗咩、有咩改變咗,同埋跟住會係點。
cando.en.a2.u28.show: 佢哋可以喺一次複習環節入面,將成個 Arc 2 嘅嘢串連埋一齊。
cando.en.b1.u01.past-habits: 佢哋可以用 used to 同 would 講以前有而而家冇嘅習慣同日常。
cando.en.b1.u01.story: 佢哋可以講一個故事,將背景細節同順序發生嘅事交織埋一齊。
cando.en.b1.u02.order: 佢哋可以將兩件過去嘅事排先後,標明邊件事先發生。
cando.en.b1.u02.what-had-happened: 佢哋可以講一件事發生之前,已經發生咗咩。
cando.en.b1.u03.duration: 佢哋可以用 for 同 since 講一樣嘢已經持續咗幾耐。
cando.en.b1.u03.result-or-activity: 佢哋可以分清一個已完成嘅結果同一個可能仲喺度進行緊嘅活動。
cando.en.b1.u04.articles: 佢哋可以用返更細緻嘅冠詞規則——最高級或者獨一無二嘅嘢用 the、餐飲同語言唔用冠詞、職業同比率用 a/an。
cando.en.b1.u04.best-ever: 佢哋可以用最高級加現在完成式同 ever,將一個經歷評為最好或者最差。
cando.en.b1.u05.future-in-progress: 佢哋可以形容自己未來某一刻會喺度做緊咩。
cando.en.b1.u05.suggestions-offers: 佢哋可以用 Shall we 同 Shall I 提出建議同提議幫手。
cando.en.b1.u06.hypotheticals: 佢哋可以用 if 加過去式再加 would,想像一個唔真實嘅現在或者未來,同埋講出原因。
cando.en.b1.u06.real-or-imagined: 佢哋可以分清一個真嘅可能同一個假想嘅可能,識揀用 if 加 will 定係 if 加 would。
cando.en.b1.u07.if-only: 佢哋可以用 if only 令一個願望更加打動人心。
cando.en.b1.u07.wishes: 佢哋可以用 wish 加過去式講一個對而家嘅願望,表示嗰件事並唔係真。
cando.en.b1.u08.prepare-in-case: 佢哋可以用 in case 為一個可能性做準備,同埋用 as long as 講一個條件。
cando.en.b1.u08.warn-unless: 佢哋可以用 unless 就一個要視乎條件而定嘅結果提出警告。
cando.en.b1.u09.deduction: 佢哋可以用 must、might 同 can't be 衡量一樣嘢有幾肯定,同埋解釋證據。
cando.en.b1.u10.obligation-past: 佢哋可以講自己以前一定要做咩,同埋將來一定要做咩。
cando.en.b1.u10.permission-any-tense: 佢哋可以講返任何時態入面,以前准唔准做咩。
cando.en.b1.u11.made-or-let: 佢哋可以講人哋逼咗或者由得自己做咩,同埋自己逼或者由得人哋做咩。
cando.en.b1.u11.want-someone-to: 佢哋可以講自己想、要求、話俾人聽,或者期望另一個人做咩。
cando.en.b1.u12.processes: 佢哋可以用現在被動式,解釋一樣嘢係點整、點用或者點生產出嚟,而唔使講邊個做嘅。
cando.en.b1.u13.built: 佢哋可以用過去被動式,講一樣嘢幾時同點樣起、整、寫或者發現出嚟。
cando.en.b1.u13.passive-by: 佢哋可以用 by 喺過去被動句加返做嗰件事嘅人,不過只喺嗰個細節係重點嗰陣先加。
cando.en.b1.u14.report-speech: 佢哋可以轉述人哋講過咩,適當咁將時態推後。
cando.en.b1.u14.say-or-tell: 佢哋可以轉述人哋講嘅嘢嗰陣,啱啱地揀 say 定 tell。
cando.en.b1.u15.reported-questions: 佢哋可以轉述人哋問過咩,是非問句保留 if 或者 whether,wh- 問句就變返做同肯定句一樣嘅詞序。
cando.en.b1.u15.reported-requests: 佢哋可以轉述人哋叫或者要求自己做咩,用 tell 或者 ask 加賓語再加 to-不定式。
cando.en.b1.u16.drop-relative: 佢哋可以喺 who、which 或者 that 做加插細節嘅賓語嗰陣將佢省略,好似 "the neighborhood I love" 咁。
cando.en.b1.u16.where-whose: 佢哋可以用「嗰度」定義一個地方或者用「係邊個嘅」定義一個人,好似 "the street where I live" 同 "a neighbor whose garden is full of flowers" 咁。
cando.en.b1.u17.verb-pattern-contrast: 佢哋可以喺 remember、stop 同 try 後面啱揀 -ing 定 to,仲知道意思點樣改變。
cando.en.b1.u17.verb-pattern-more: 佢哋可以喺 suggest、avoid、mind 同 keep 後面用 -ing。
cando.en.b1.u18.phrasal-idioms: 佢哋可以用意思唔係由字面砌出嚟嘅常用 phrasal verb 組合——find out、give up、run out——去解決一個日常問題。
cando.en.b1.u18.phrasal-separable: 佢哋可以將代名詞放喺日常可分開嘅 phrasal verb 中間,好似 turn it on 或者 put it away 咁。
cando.en.b1.u19.linking: 佢哋可以用 however、therefore 同 instead 連接唔同句子入面嘅諗法,做對比或者落結論。
cando.en.b1.u19.purpose: 佢哋可以用 in order to 同 so that 更完整咁表達目的。
cando.en.b1.u20.echoes: 佢哋可以用 so 或者 neither 覆述人哋嘅動詞,表示同意。
cando.en.b1.u20.tags: 佢哋可以喺句尾加一個簡短嘅附加問句,確認或者核實一樣嘢。
cando.en.b1.u21.indefinites: 佢哋可以正確咁一齊用 some-、any-、no- 同 every- 呢類字,講唔特定嘅人、嘢同地方。
cando.en.b1.u22.reactions: 佢哋可以對睇過或者聽過嘅嘢作出反應同解釋原因,啱啱咁揀用 -ed 定 -ing 形容詞。
cando.en.b1.u23.results: 佢哋可以用 too...to、so...that 同 such a,喺一個描述入面帶出一個結果——too slow to catch it、so strong that it broke、such a close game。
cando.en.b1.u24.indirect-questions: 佢哋可以用 Could you tell me、Do you know 或者 I was wondering 令問題柔和啲,有禮貌咁攞資訊。
cando.en.b1.u25.pairs: 佢哋可以用 both、either 同 neither 講一樣嘢係咪兩個人或者兩樣嘢都啱、淨係一個啱、定係兩個都唔啱。
cando.en.b1.u25.preferences: 佢哋可以講兩樣嘢入面自己比較鍾意邊樣,同埋問人哋會情願要邊樣。
cando.en.b1.u26.work-life: 佢哋可以講一份工、一個事業同埋啲同事,仲可以由兩個角度重講一次見工——答問題同轉述人哋問咗同講咗咩。
cando.en.b1.u27.big-questions: 佢哋可以就一個大問題表態,用一個假設同一個原因支持自己,再用 however/therefore 同一個推論將啲諗法連埋一齊。
cando.en.b1.u28.review: 佢哋可以將故事、假設情況、人哋講過嘅嘢同自己嘅意見,一齊擺埋一個講述入面。
cando.en.b1.u29.five-stories: 佢哋可以做一個簡短嘅口頭同書面作品集:一個包含過去完成式事件嘅過去敘述、一個假設、一段轉述對話、一個被動式嘅過程描述,同埋一個用埋話語連接詞嘅意見。
cando.en.b1.u30.show: 佢哋可以喺一次複習環節入面,將成個 Arc 3 嘅嘢串連埋一齊。
gn.en.gn.adj-ed-ing.note: -ing 形式形容引起嗰種感覺嘅嘢;-ed 形式形容感覺本身:"the film is boring, so I'm bored."
gn.en.gn.adj-ed-ing.title: -ed 定 -ing 形容詞
gn.en.gn.adv-degree.note: Very、really、quite 同 too 擺喺形容詞前面,將個程度推高或者推低:"really tired, quite good, too late."
gn.en.gn.adv-degree.title: 程度副詞
gn.en.gn.adv-freq.note: "usually"、"often" 同 "sometimes" 呢啲字係用嚟講一個習慣有幾密發生。佢哋會擺喺主要動詞前面，同埋 "be" 動詞後面，例如："I usually walk. She is often late."
gn.en.gn.adv-freq.title: 頻率副詞
gn.en.gn.adv-manner.note: 加 -ly 形容一個動作點樣發生:"She speaks slowly." 有幾個字保持自己原本嘅形狀——well、fast、hard。
gn.en.gn.adv-manner.title: 方式副詞
gn.en.gn.art-the.note: "The" 係指我哋兩個都知嘅嘢，例如 "the station"、"the sun"，或者第二次提及嘅嘢。一般嘅眾數名詞會省略 "the"，例如："I like dogs."
gn.en.gn.art-the.title: the (基本)
gn.en.gn.articles-a-an.note: 喺輔音開頭嘅音前面用 "a"，喺元音開頭嘅音前面用 "an"：a book, an apple, an hour。佢係指一件唔特定嘅嘢。
gn.en.gn.articles-a-an.title: a / an
gn.en.gn.articles-deep.note: The 標記獨一無二嘅嘢、最高級或者一條河;零冠詞就啱餐飲、語言同大部分街道;a 或者 an 就啱職業同比率:"the fastest, breakfast, twice a day."
gn.en.gn.articles-deep.title: 冠詞:更細緻嘅規則
gn.en.gn.as-as.note: "As … as" 標示兩樣嘢一樣(as tall as me),"not as … as" 就標示一樣冇咁多:"It's not as cheap as before."
gn.en.gn.as-as.title: as … as
gn.en.gn.be-1sg-2sg.note: "Am" 配 "I"，"are" 配 "you"： "I am Anna. You are my friend." 呢兩種形式係你第一次介紹自己嗰陣用嘅。
gn.en.gn.be-1sg-2sg.title: be 動詞：I am / you are
gn.en.gn.be-all.note: "Am"、"is" 同 "are" 用喺所有嘅人稱：he、she 同 it 用 "is"；we、you 同 they 用 "are"。例如："She is a doctor. They are from Peru."
gn.en.gn.be-all.title: be 動詞：完整現在式
gn.en.gn.be-allowed-to.note: "Be allowed to" 喺任何時態都可以表達許可:"We weren't allowed to talk in class. You're allowed to park here."
gn.en.gn.be-allowed-to.title: be allowed to
gn.en.gn.be-neg.note: 喺 "be" 動詞後面加 "not"： "I am not tired. She isn't here." 縮寫形式嘅 "isn't" 同 "aren't" 喺講嘢嗰陣聽起嚟最自然。
gn.en.gn.be-neg.title: be 動詞：否定句
gn.en.gn.be-yesno-q.note: 將 "be" 動詞調去句首："You are tired." 會變成 "Are you tired?" 單單係詞序就令佢變成問題，唔使加其他字。
gn.en.gn.be-yesno-q.title: be 動詞嘅是非題
gn.en.gn.can-ability.note: "I can swim. He can't drive." 每個主語都係用同一個形式，而後面嘅動詞會用原型。
gn.en.gn.can-ability.title: can / can't (能力)
gn.en.gn.can-request.note: "Can I have the menu? Can you help me?" 呢啲係日常有禮貌嘅請求，可以用嚟問准許同埋幫忙。
gn.en.gn.can-request.title: can (請求)
gn.en.gn.comp-adverbs.note: 想比較一樣嘢做得點,用 more、-er 或者一個不規則形式加 than:"She types more quickly. He runs faster. They play better than us."
gn.en.gn.comp-adverbs.title: 比較副詞
gn.en.gn.comp-superl.note: 短形容詞會加 "-er" 同 "-est" (older, the oldest)；長形容詞就用 "more" 同 "most"。 "Good" 會變成 "better" 同 "best"。同 "than" 一齊比較："My city is bigger than yours."
gn.en.gn.comp-superl.title: 比較級同最高級
gn.en.gn.cond-first-vs-second.note: 第一條件句衡量一個有可能發生嘅計劃;第二條件句就想像一啲唔太可能發生嘅嘢:"If it rains, we'll stay in" 對比 "If I won the lottery, I'd travel."
gn.en.gn.cond-first-vs-second.title: 真實定假想?
gn.en.gn.cond-first.note: If 加現在式,再加 will,講一個真實嘅未來可能性:"If it rains, we'll stay in." Will 唔會出現喺 if 嗰一半入面。
gn.en.gn.cond-first.title: 第一條件句
gn.en.gn.cond-second.note: If 加一個過去式,跟住 would 加動詞,想像一個唔真實嘅現在或者未來:"If I had more time, I would travel."
gn.en.gn.cond-second.title: 第二條件句
gn.en.gn.cond-zero.note: If 加現在式,現在式,講一般嚟講都係真嘅嘢:"If you heat ice, it melts." 兩邊都保持現在式。
gn.en.gn.cond-zero.title: 零條件句
gn.en.gn.conn-basic.note: 連接諗法： "I like tea and coffee. It's small but nice. I stayed home because I was tired."
gn.en.gn.conn-basic.title: and / but / because
gn.en.gn.conn-discourse.note: However、therefore 同 instead 將一句連接去下一句:"It was late. However, we kept going."
gn.en.gn.conn-discourse.title: however / therefore / instead
gn.en.gn.could-past-polite.note: Could 可以望返一個過去嘅能力("I could swim at five"),又可以令而家嘅請求柔和啲("Could you help me?")。
gn.en.gn.could-past-polite.title: could
gn.en.gn.count-uncount.note: 有啲名詞——water、money、rice——當成一舊嘢咁對待:冇眾數 -s,前面都冇 "a"。其他就好似平時咁一個個數。
gn.en.gn.count-uncount.title: 可數同不可數
gn.en.gn.dem-sg.note: "This" 係指你身邊近嘅嘢，而 "that" 係指遠啲嘅嘢： "This is my phone. That is your bag."
gn.en.gn.dem-sg.title: this / that
gn.en.gn.do-neg.note: "I don't know. She doesn't eat meat." 用 "Don't" 或者 "doesn't" 加動詞原型 — 個 "-s" 會移去 "does" 度，動詞就變返原型。
gn.en.gn.do-neg.title: 用 "don't/doesn't" 嘅否定句
gn.en.gn.do-quest.note: "Do you like tea? Does she work here?" "Do" 或者 "does" 會放喺問題嘅開頭，而主要動詞會用原型。
gn.en.gn.do-quest.title: 用 "do/does" 嘅問句
gn.en.gn.dummy-it.note: 英文就算講天氣同時間，都需要一個主語： "It is raining. It's cold. It's late." 個 "it" 其實冇指住任何嘢，佢只係填補咗主語嘅位置。
gn.en.gn.dummy-it.title: it (天氣同時間)
gn.en.gn.echo-so-neither.note: 覆述返嗰個助動詞嚟表示同意:"I love it." "So do I." 肯定句嘅回應用 so,否定句嘅回應就用 neither。
gn.en.gn.echo-so-neither.title: So do I / Neither do I
gn.en.gn.few-little.note: A few 配可數名詞,a little 配不可數名詞;去咗個 "a",few 或者 little 就暗示唔夠:"a few friends" 對比 "few friends."
gn.en.gn.few-little.title: (a) few / (a) little
gn.en.gn.for-since.note: For 度量一段時間長度(for two years);since 就講出開始嗰個時間點(since 2020)。兩個都自然咁同現在完成式一齊用。
gn.en.gn.for-since.title: for / since
gn.en.gn.future-cont.note: Will be 加 -ing 描繪一個喺未來某一刻進行緊嘅動作:"This time tomorrow I'll be flying."
gn.en.gn.future-cont.title: 未來進行式
gn.en.gn.gerund-after-verbs.note: 喺 like、love、hate、enjoy、mind 同 stop 後面,跟住嗰個動詞要用 -ing:"I enjoy cooking. Do you mind waiting?"
gn.en.gn.gerund-after-verbs.title: verb + -ing
gn.en.gn.going-to.note: "Be" 動詞加 "going to" 再加動詞，用嚟講計劃： "I'm going to visit my aunt tomorrow. We're going to travel in June."
gn.en.gn.going-to.title: going to (計劃)
gn.en.gn.had-to.note: 義務會隨時間轉變:"I had to wear a uniform" 係望返轉頭,"You'll have to book early" 就係望前面。
gn.en.gn.had-to.title: had to / will have to
gn.en.gn.have-got.note: 擁有： "I have two brothers. She has a car." 你可能都會聽到 "have got" — 當佢係同一個意思就得。
gn.en.gn.have-got.title: have / has
gn.en.gn.have-to.note: Have to 講出一個義務;don't have to 就係話冇呢個義務——唔係話禁止做:"I have to work" 對比 "You don't have to come."
gn.en.gn.have-to.title: have to / don't have to
gn.en.gn.how-much-many.note: "How many" 用喺數得清嘅嘢 (How many apples?)，而 "how much" 用喺數唔清嘅嘢 (How much water?)。問價錢就用 "How much is it?"
gn.en.gn.how-much-many.title: How much / How many
gn.en.gn.if-only.note: "If only" 令一個願望更加打動人心:"If only it were warmer." 佢用嘅係同 wish 一樣嘅過去式機制。
gn.en.gn.if-only.title: If only
gn.en.gn.imperatives.note: 用動詞原型嚟叫人做嘢： "Turn left. Wait here. Please don't stop." 加 "please" 會令語氣友善啲。
gn.en.gn.imperatives.title: 祈使句
gn.en.gn.in-case-as-long-as.note: In case 為一個可能性做準備("take an umbrella in case it rains");as long as 就定一個條件("you can stay as long as you're quiet")。
gn.en.gn.in-case-as-long-as.title: in case / as long as
gn.en.gn.in-order-to.note: "In order to" 同 "so that" 更完整咁講出目的:"in order to save time, so that everyone can hear."
gn.en.gn.in-order-to.title: in order to / so that
gn.en.gn.indef-pronouns.note: 將 some-、any-、no- 同 every- 同 body、thing、where 組合埋一齊,跟返 some/any 嗰種正負規則:"someone called, but nobody answered."
gn.en.gn.indef-pronouns.title: somebody / anything / nowhere
gn.en.gn.indirect-questions.note: 喺一個有禮貌嘅框架入面,裏面嗰個問句會變返做正常詞序:"Where is the station?" 會變成 "Could you tell me where the station is?"
gn.en.gn.indirect-questions.title: Could you tell me where…?
gn.en.gn.infinitive-after-verbs.note: 喺 want、need、hope、decide 同 would like 後面,跟住嗰個動詞要加 "to":"I want to go. She decided to stay."
gn.en.gn.infinitive-after-verbs.title: verb + to-infinitive
gn.en.gn.infinitive-purpose.note: "To + 動詞" 答返你點解做一件事:"I came to help." 佢帶住 "in order to" 嗰種意思。
gn.en.gn.infinitive-purpose.title: 表達目的嘅不定式
gn.en.gn.like-want-noun.note: 動詞加名詞，中間唔使加嘢： "I like coffee. I want water." 鍾意嗰個人就係主語。
gn.en.gn.like-want-noun.title: like / want + 名詞
gn.en.gn.make-let.note: 喺 make 同 let 後面,個賓語跟住嘅動詞唔加 "to":"They made us wait. She let me drive."
gn.en.gn.make-let.title: make / let + bare verb
gn.en.gn.might-may.note: Might 同 may 指向可能性,唔係肯定:"It might rain. She may be late." 兩個都令個結果保持開放。
gn.en.gn.might-may.title: might / may
gn.en.gn.modal-deduction.note: 情態動詞可以衡量你有幾肯定:"It must be cold out. She can't be home yet. He might be busy." 個動詞反映緊嗰個證據。
gn.en.gn.modal-deduction.title: must / might / can't be
gn.en.gn.much-many-alot.note: Many 配可數名詞,much 配不可數名詞,a lot of 就兩樣都啱用:"many books, much time, a lot of either."
gn.en.gn.much-many-alot.title: much / many / a lot of
gn.en.gn.must-mustnt.note: Must 標示一個強嘅規則;mustn't 標示禁止,呢個同 don't have to 係唔同嘅諗法:"You mustn't park here."
gn.en.gn.must-mustnt.title: must / mustn't
gn.en.gn.narrative-tenses.note: 一個故事會將簡單過去式用喺事件、過去進行式用喺背景,再加 first、then、finally 呢啲排序詞推動故事發展:"I was walking home when I saw her, so I stopped."
gn.en.gn.narrative-tenses.title: 用過去式講故事
gn.en.gn.numbers-1-100.note: 數到一百，要留意 "-teen" 同 "-ty" 嘅陷阱："thirteen" 同 "thirty" 聽起嚟好似，所以重音可以分開佢哋。
gn.en.gn.numbers-1-100.title: 數字 1–100
gn.en.gn.obj-pron.note: Me, you, him, her, it, us, them — 佢哋會放喺動詞後面： "Call me. I see her. Ask him."
gn.en.gn.obj-pron.title: 受格代名詞
gn.en.gn.passive-by.note: 淨係喺嗰個做嘅人係重點嘅時候,先用 "by" 講出嚟:"It was painted by my sister." 如果唔係,被動式可以將佢省略。
gn.en.gn.passive-by.title: by + 施動者
gn.en.gn.passive-past.note: 過去被動式將 was 或者 were 同過去分詞配埋一齊:"The bridge was built in 1900. The letters were sent yesterday."
gn.en.gn.passive-past.title: 過去被動式
gn.en.gn.passive-present.note: Be 加過去分詞將焦點由邊個做,轉去發生咗咩:"Rice is grown here." 做嗰件事嘅人可以唔講出嚟。
gn.en.gn.passive-present.title: 現在被動式
gn.en.gn.past-be.note: "be" 動詞嘅過去式：I、he、she 同 it 用 "was"；you、we 同 they 用 "were"。 "I was at home. They were happy."
gn.en.gn.past-be.title: was / were
gn.en.gn.past-cont.note: 用 was 或者 were 加 -ing 動詞,講一樣嘢喺過去某一刻進行緊:"I was cooking when you called." 佢係鋪陳場景,唔係講一件完咗嘅事。
gn.en.gn.past-cont.title: 過去進行式
gn.en.gn.past-irreg-top25.note: 最常用嘅動詞喺過去式會變形：go 變 went，have 變 had，see 變 saw，do 變 did，get 變 got，make 變 made。
gn.en.gn.past-irreg-top25.title: 不規則過去式 (常用動詞)
gn.en.gn.past-perfect-vs-past.note: 過去完成式標示先發生嗰步;喺 before、after 或者 by the time 後面,個次序通常已經夠清楚:"After she left, we ate."
gn.en.gn.past-perfect-vs-past.title: 過去事件嘅先後次序
gn.en.gn.past-perfect.note: Had 加過去分詞標示兩件過去事入面較早嗰件:"The train had left when I arrived." 佢再向前多退一步。
gn.en.gn.past-perfect.title: 過去完成式
gn.en.gn.past-quest-neg.note: "Did you see it? I didn't go." "Did" 已經帶有過去式嘅意思，所以主要動詞會變返原型。
gn.en.gn.past-quest-neg.title: did：問句同否定句
gn.en.gn.past-reg.note: 喺完成咗嘅動作後面加 "-ed"： "I worked. She visited her mother." 每個主語都係用同一個形式。
gn.en.gn.past-reg.title: 簡單過去式：-ed
gn.en.gn.past-simple-vs-cont.note: 一個較長嘅背景動作(was 或者 were + -ing)通常會俾一個簡單過去式嘅快動作打斷,用 when 或者 while 連接:"I was reading when the lights went out."
gn.en.gn.past-simple-vs-cont.title: 被打斷嘅過去
gn.en.gn.perf-cont-vs-simple.note: "I've painted the room" 指向一個完成咗嘅結果;"I've been painting" 就指向嗰個活動,可能仲繼續緊。一個計嗰個結果,另一個計嗰個過程。
gn.en.gn.perf-cont-vs-simple.title: 結果定係持續?
gn.en.gn.phrasal-separable.note: 有啲 phrasal verb 會喺賓語兩邊分開,代名詞就擺喺中間:"turn the light on" 或者 "turn it on."
gn.en.gn.phrasal-separable.title: 可分開嘅 phrasal verb
gn.en.gn.phrasal-verbs-1.note: 一個動詞加一個細細嘅助詞可以改變意思:get up、turn on、look for、put on。呢對字組成一個單一嘅諗法。
gn.en.gn.phrasal-verbs-1.title: Phrasal verbs I
gn.en.gn.phrasal-verbs-2.note: 仲有其他日常組合——find out、give up、carry on、look after、run out of、sort out——帶住一啲你單睇字面估唔到嘅意思。
gn.en.gn.phrasal-verbs-2.title: Phrasal verbs II
gn.en.gn.plural-irreg.note: 有啲名詞唔係加 "-s"，而係會變形：man 變 men，woman 變 women，child 變 children，person 變 people，foot 變 feet。
gn.en.gn.plural-irreg.title: 不規則眾數
gn.en.gn.plural-reg.note: 多過一個嗰陣就加 "-s"，或者喺 s, sh, ch, x 後面加 "-es"：one cat, two cats; one box, two boxes。
gn.en.gn.plural-reg.title: 規則眾數
gn.en.gn.poss-adj.note: My, your, his, her, its, our, their — 將佢哋擺喺名詞前面： "her book", "our house", "their names"。
gn.en.gn.poss-adj.title: 物主形容詞
gn.en.gn.poss-pron.note: Mine、yours、his、hers、ours 同 theirs 可以獨立用,後面唔跟名詞:"That book is mine."
gn.en.gn.poss-pron.title: 物主代名詞
gn.en.gn.poss-s.note: 喺擁有者後面加 "'s"： "Anna's dog", "my brother's car"。英文會將擁有者擺喺前面，被擁有嘅嘢擺喺後面。
gn.en.gn.poss-s.title: 所有格 's
gn.en.gn.prep-movement.note: Into、out of、through、across、along、past 同 over 形容行進嘅方向,而唔係一個固定嘅地方:"walk through the park, across the bridge."
gn.en.gn.prep-movement.title: 表達移動嘅介詞
gn.en.gn.prep-place.note: In, on, under, next to, behind, in front of, between — 呢啲係講位置嘅小詞： "The keys are on the table."
gn.en.gn.prep-place.title: 地方介詞
gn.en.gn.pres-cont-future.note: 現在進行式可以指向一個有固定時間嘅安排:"I'm meeting Ana at six." 嗰個時間詞令佢唔會聽落好似即刻噉解。
gn.en.gn.pres-cont-future.title: 現在進行式表達既定安排
gn.en.gn.pres-cont.note: "Be" 動詞加動詞 "-ing" 形式，用嚟講而家發生緊嘅事： "I am eating. They are working. Look, it is raining."
gn.en.gn.pres-cont.title: 現在進行式
gn.en.gn.pres-perf-been-gone.note: "Has been to" 即係去咗又返咗嚟;"has gone to" 即係仲喺嗰度:"She has been to Paris" 對比 "She has gone to Paris."
gn.en.gn.pres-perf-been-gone.title: been vs gone
gn.en.gn.pres-perf-cont.note: Have 或者 has been 加 -ing 形容一個仲喺度進行緊或者啱啱停低嘅動作:"I've been waiting for an hour." 佢重點喺個活動維持咗幾耐。
gn.en.gn.pres-perf-cont.title: 現在完成進行式
gn.en.gn.pres-perf-exp.note: Have 或者 has 加過去分詞講人生經驗,唔使講幾時:"I have visited Rome." 重點唔係嗰一刻,而係嗰個經驗。
gn.en.gn.pres-perf-exp.title: 現在完成式:經驗
gn.en.gn.pres-perf-vs-past.note: 一個已經完結嘅時間詞(yesterday、last week)要用簡單過去式;一個未完結或者冇講明嘅時間就用現在完成式。"I saw it yesterday" 但係 "I have seen it."
gn.en.gn.pres-perf-vs-past.title: 現在完成式 vs 簡單過去式
gn.en.gn.pres-perf-yet-already.note: Already 標示一樣嘢做得比預期早;yet 喺問句同否定句度問或者否認;just 指向啱啱過去嗰段時間:"I've just eaten. Have you finished yet?"
gn.en.gn.pres-perf-yet-already.title: already / yet / just
gn.en.gn.pres-simple-3sg.note: 喺 he、she 同 it 後面，動詞會加 "-s"： "She works. He watches." 佢係英文入面最容易俾人唔記得嘅字母，所以要特別留意。
gn.en.gn.pres-simple-3sg.title: 第三人稱單數 -s
gn.en.gn.pres-simple-base.note: 講習慣同事實嗰陣，用動詞原型： "I work at home. They live in Lima." 呢啲主語後面嘅動詞唔使變尾。
gn.en.gn.pres-simple-base.title: 簡單現在式：I / you / we / they
gn.en.gn.pron-subject.note: I, you, he, she, it, we, they。英文幾乎每句都要將主語講出嚟 — "am tired" 需要佢嘅 "I"。
gn.en.gn.pron-subject.title: 主格代名詞
gn.en.gn.question-tags.note: 附加問句反映返嗰個助動詞,再將正負反轉:"It's cold, isn't it? You don't mind, do you?"
gn.en.gn.question-tags.title: 附加問句
gn.en.gn.question-words-deep.note: 當個疑問詞係主語嗰陣,唔使用 do:"Who called you?" 當佢係賓語嗰陣就要用:"Who did you call?" 對比返 "What happened?"
gn.en.gn.question-words-deep.title: 主語問句 vs 賓語問句
gn.en.gn.reflexive.note: 當主語同賓語係同一個人嗰陣,用 myself、yourself、herself 呢啲字:"I hurt myself. Help yourselves."
gn.en.gn.reflexive.title: 反身代名詞
gn.en.gn.rel-object-omit.note: 當關係詞係賓語嗰陣,英文容許你將佢省略:"the film we watched" 同 "the film that we watched" 一樣啱。
gn.en.gn.rel-object-omit.title: 省略關係代名詞
gn.en.gn.rel-where-whose.note: Where 指向一個地方,whose 指向擁有者:"the town where I grew up, the writer whose book won."
gn.en.gn.rel-where-whose.title: Relatives: where / whose
gn.en.gn.rel-who-which.note: 人用 who,嘢就用 which 或者 that,加一個必要嘅細節:"the man who lives here, the bag that fits."
gn.en.gn.rel-who-which.title: 關係子句(限定性)
gn.en.gn.reported-commands.note: 用 tell 或者 ask 加賓語再加 to-不定式,轉述一個請求或者命令:"She told me to wait. He asked us not to call."
gn.en.gn.reported-commands.title: 轉述請求同命令
gn.en.gn.reported-questions.note: 轉述問句唔用問句詞序,讀起上嚟好似肯定句咁:"Where do you live?" 變成 "He asked where I lived." 是非問句就用 if 或者 whether。
gn.en.gn.reported-questions.title: 轉述問句
gn.en.gn.reported-statements.note: 想轉述人哋講過嘅嘢,將時態推後一格:"I'm tired" 就變成 "She said (that) she was tired."
gn.en.gn.reported-statements.title: 轉述句:陳述句
gn.en.gn.say-vs-tell.note: Tell 後面即刻要跟一個人(tell me);say 就唔使(say that…):"She told me the news" 但係 "She said the news was good."
gn.en.gn.say-vs-tell.title: say / tell
gn.en.gn.shall-suggest.note: Shall 加 I 或者 we 用嚟提議或者建議:"Shall we start? Shall I open the window?"
gn.en.gn.shall-suggest.title: Shall we…?
gn.en.gn.should-advice.note: Should 同 shouldn't 提出建議或者意見,後面跟一個唔加 to 嘅動詞:"You should rest. You shouldn't skip breakfast."
gn.en.gn.should-advice.title: should / shouldn't
gn.en.gn.simple-vs-cont.note: "I drink coffee every day" 係一個習慣；"I am drinking coffee" 係指呢一刻。時間詞係你嘅線索。
gn.en.gn.simple-vs-cont.title: 習慣定而家？
gn.en.gn.so-because-although.note: So 帶出一個結果,because 帶出一個原因,although 就帶出一個對比:"It was late, so we left. We stayed because it was warm, although it rained."
gn.en.gn.so-because-although.title: so / because / although
gn.en.gn.some-any.note: "Some" 用喺肯定句 ("I have some money")，而 "any" 用喺否定句同問句 ("Do you have any money?")。
gn.en.gn.some-any.title: some / any
gn.en.gn.superl-perf-ever.note: 一個最高級同現在完成式加 ever 夾埋一齊,評定一個經歷:"It's the best film I have ever seen."
gn.en.gn.superl-perf-ever.title: The best I've ever…
gn.en.gn.sv-order.note: 英文句子嘅順序係主語–動詞–賓語： "I eat apples." 呢個順序帶出意思，所以要將做動作嘅人擺喺前面，動作擺喺後面。
gn.en.gn.sv-order.title: 基本詞序
gn.en.gn.there-is-are.note: 用嚟講有啲嘢存在： "There is a bank. There are two cafes." 根據你想講嘅數量，配返 "is" 或者 "are"。
gn.en.gn.there-is-are.title: there is / there are
gn.en.gn.time-clauses.note: 喺 when、as soon as、before 或者 after 後面,英文用現在式表達未來嘅意思:"When I arrive, I'll call you"——唔係 "when I will arrive."
gn.en.gn.time-clauses.title: 未來時間子句
gn.en.gn.time-prep.note: "At" 用喺鐘點時間 (at five)，"on" 用喺星期同日期 (on Monday)，"in" 用喺月份、年份同埋一日嘅唔同時間 (in May, in the morning)。
gn.en.gn.time-prep.title: at / on / in (時間)
gn.en.gn.time-telling.note: 用 "It's" 開頭： "It's three o'clock. It's half past two. It's seven fifteen." 就算冇講到任何嘢嘅名，個 "it" 都會留喺度。
gn.en.gn.time-telling.title: 講時間
gn.en.gn.too-enough.note: Too 擺喺形容詞前面,話多過你想要嘅(too hot);enough 就擺喺形容詞後面、名詞前面(warm enough, enough time)。
gn.en.gn.too-enough.title: too / enough
gn.en.gn.too-to-so-that.note: "Too … to" 同 "so … that" 將一個結果砌入形容詞入面:"too tired to drive, so tired that I slept."
gn.en.gn.too-to-so-that.title: too…to / so…that
gn.en.gn.unless.note: Unless 即係 if…not:"We'll miss it unless we leave now." 一個字就帶住成個否定條件。
gn.en.gn.unless.title: unless
gn.en.gn.used-to-vs-would.note: Used to 同 would 都可以重播過去重複嘅動作:"We would swim every summer." 不過講過去嘅狀態,就要用 used to,would 唔得。
gn.en.gn.used-to-vs-would.title: used to / would (past habits)
gn.en.gn.used-to.note: "Used to" 形容一個唔再存在嘅過去習慣或者狀態:"I used to live in Lima." 後面嘅動詞保持原型——used to live,唔係 used to lived。
gn.en.gn.used-to.title: used to
gn.en.gn.verb-obj-inf.note: Want、ask、tell 同 expect 呢類動詞跟住一個賓語再加 to-不定式:"I want you to listen. She asked me to wait."
gn.en.gn.verb-obj-inf.title: want someone to do
gn.en.gn.verb-patterns-contrast.note: 用 remember、stop 同 try,個句式會改變意思:"stop smoking"(戒咗佢)對比 "stop to smoke"(停低嚟做)。
gn.en.gn.verb-patterns-contrast.title: remember / stop / try + -ing or to
gn.en.gn.verb-patterns-more.note: Suggest、avoid、mind 同 keep 全部都用 -ing:"I suggest leaving early. Keep trying. I don't mind waiting."
gn.en.gn.verb-patterns-more.title: suggest / avoid / mind / keep
gn.en.gn.verb-prep-collocations.note: 有啲動詞會同一個固定嘅介詞一齊出現:listen to、wait for、look at、depend on。呢啲配搭值得成組咁記。
gn.en.gn.verb-prep-collocations.title: verb + preposition
gn.en.gn.wh-quest-be.note: What, where, who, 或者 how，然後係 "be" 動詞，再係主語： "Where are you? What is this? Who is that?"
gn.en.gn.wh-quest-be.title: be 動詞嘅 Wh-問句
gn.en.gn.will-decide-offer.note: 講嘢嗰陣即場決定、提議或者承諾就用 will:"I'll help you. I'll get it." 呢個選擇係即刻做嘅。
gn.en.gn.will-decide-offer.title: will (decisions & offers)
gn.en.gn.will-predict.note: Will 加原型動詞講一個關於未來嘅預測或者事實:"It will rain later." 呢個形式喺唔同人稱都一樣。
gn.en.gn.will-predict.title: will (predictions)
gn.en.gn.will-vs-going-to.note: Going to 啱一個已經諗好嘅計劃或者你見到嘅證據;will 就啱一個預測或者即場嘅決定:"We're going to paint" 對比 "I'll paint it."
gn.en.gn.will-vs-going-to.title: will vs going to
gn.en.gn.wish-past.note: 關於而家嘅願望用過去式:"I wish I had a garden. I wish I could stay." 個過去式形狀就係話緊呢件事並唔係咁。
gn.en.gn.wish-past.title: wish + past
gn.en.gn.would-like-offers.note: "Would you like…?" 有禮貌咁提議,"I'd like…" 就溫柔咁要求一樣嘢:"Would you like a coffee? I'd like to book a table."
gn.en.gn.would-like-offers.title: would you like…?
gn.en.gn.would-like.note: "I'd like a coffee, please" 係有禮貌咁叫嘢或者請求嘢嘅方式 — 比 "I want" 語氣更柔和。
gn.en.gn.would-like.title: I'd like (有禮貌)
ovl.es.en.a1.u10.note: 講工作嗰陣,呢幾個字要留意返:actually 意思係『其實』,唔係『而家』;assist 通常指正式咁『協助』;exit 淨係『出口』嘅意思,同『成功』冇關。
ovl.es.en.a1.u12.note: 英文形容詞擺喺名詞前面,而且唔會有眾數 -s:『the red cars』唔係『the cars reds』。
ovl.es.en.a1.u24.note: 『呢個係邊個嘅?』得一個字就得:『Whose is this?』——whose 已經做晒『邊個嘅』呢份工作。
ovl.es.en.a2.u18.note: 留意呢兩個字唔同:pretend 係『扮嘢、假裝』,同『打算、有意圖』冇關;講『打算』要用 intend 或者 aim。
ovl.es.en.a2.u22.note: 表達意見嗰陣,留意 discuss 同 argue 唔同:discuss 係心平氣和咁交流意見,argue 就係嗌交、爭論。
ovl.es.en.b1.u03.note: 同健康有關嘅字要留心:cold 先係『傷風感冒』,bother 先係『打攪』,pregnant 先係『懷孕』——呢幾個字嘅英文意思要記清楚,唔好靠估。
ovl.es.en.b1.u22.note: 反應嗰陣留意:argument 通常指『爭論』,故事嘅『情節』要講 plot;a success 先係『成功』,普通『事件』就講 event;sensible 係『明智、理性』,唔係『敏感』——敏感係 sensitive。
ovl.es.en.b1.u26.note: 講工作嗰陣,留意呢幾個字嘅英文用法:realize 係『意識到』,唔係『進行、完成』一件事(嗰個意思用 carry out);support 係支持,唔係『忍受』(忍受係 put up with);a job application 先係求職申請書;commitment 就係承諾,同『妥協』(compromise)唔同意思。
ovl.es.en.gn.adj-ed-ing.note: 呢個位好易撈亂:-ing 講嗰樣嘢本身有咩效果,-ed 就講你自己嘅感覺,兩個字唔可以掉亂用。
ovl.es.en.gn.adv-freq.note: 頻率副詞喺英文有固定位置:擺喺主要動詞前面、be 動詞後面,唔可以周圍擺。
ovl.es.en.gn.art-the.note: 講一般性嘅嘢,英文唔使加 the:『Life is beautiful』、『I like dogs』——呢種概括講法冠詞會唔見咗。
ovl.es.en.gn.articles-a-an.note: 講職業嗰陣,英文一定要加 a/an:『I am an engineer』——呢個冠詞唔可以慳返。
ovl.es.en.gn.articles-deep.note: 講語言同一般名詞嗰陣,英文唔使冠詞:『English is useful』——呢度冇 the。
ovl.es.en.gn.as-as.note: 呢個結構好直接:兩個 as 夾住中間個形容詞,一個都唔少。
ovl.es.en.gn.be-1sg-2sg.note: 英文淨係一個 be 動詞就搞掂晒:『I am Anna』、『I am tired』全部都用 am,唔使因應唔同意思揀第二個動詞。
ovl.es.en.gn.be-all.note: 唔理你想講嘅係狀態定係本質,英文都係用同一個 be 動詞:『the shop is open』同『the shop is small』一樣用 is。
ovl.es.en.gn.be-allowed-to.note: 『Be allowed to』可以隨時態轉,由過去講到而家都得:『I wasn't allowed to go out』、『you're allowed to park here』。
ovl.es.en.gn.be-yesno-q.note: 英文問句一定要將 be 郁去句首,唔可以淨係靠語氣:『Are you tired?』先係問句,唔郁就會俾人當肯定句。
ovl.es.en.gn.can-ability.note: 『Can』一個字就做晒能力同許可兩份工:『I can swim』(識)、『I can go』(得㗎喇)。
ovl.es.en.gn.comp-superl.note: 英文比較級分兩條路:短形容詞加 -er(bigger than),長形容詞就用 more...than。
ovl.es.en.gn.cond-first.note: 留意 will 唔會出現喺 if 嗰一半:『if it rains, we'll stay in』——if 果邊淨係現在式。
ovl.es.en.gn.cond-second.note: 呢種假設係 if 加過去式,跟住 would:『if I had time, I would travel』——would 唔會走入 if 嗰邊。
ovl.es.en.gn.cond-zero.note: 呢條規則好直接:兩邊都用返現在式,好似講一個定律咁:『if you heat ice, it melts』。
ovl.es.en.gn.conn-discourse.note: 呢兩個連接詞後面通常跟返個逗號:『It was late. However, we kept going.』
ovl.es.en.gn.could-past-polite.note: 『Could』一個字做兩份工:講返過去嘅能力,又可以令請求柔和啲:『I could swim』、『could you help?』。
ovl.es.en.gn.count-uncount.note: 有幾個字英文特登唔當可數:information、furniture、money、bread、advice——唔會有眾數,都唔加 a。『一條建議』就要講 a piece of advice。
ovl.es.en.gn.dem-sg.note: 英文淨係分兩種距離:this(近)同 that(遠)。
ovl.es.en.gn.do-neg.note: 英文淨係用一個否定字就夠:『I don't see anything』——don't 加一個肯定字,唔使兩個否定疊埋一齊。
ovl.es.en.gn.do-quest.note: 英文問句要加返 do/does:『Do you like coffee?』——單靠語氣係唔夠嘅。
ovl.es.en.gn.dummy-it.note: 講天氣同時間,英文一定要有個主語,就算冇實際指緊咩:『IT is raining. IT's late. IT's cold.』
ovl.es.en.gn.echo-so-neither.note: 覆述表示同意嗰陣要跟返個助動詞:『So am I』、『Neither can I』——唔係淨係講句『me too』。
ovl.es.en.gn.few-little.note: 留意個 "a":a little 同 a few 係『有少少』,冇咗個 a,little 同 few 就暗示緊『唔夠』。
ovl.es.en.gn.for-since.note: For 度量一段長度(for two years),since 就講開始個時間點(since 2020)。
ovl.es.en.gn.future-cont.note: 『I'll be flying』喺英文係好日常嘅講法,唔係話特登正式,隨時可以用嚟講未來某一刻做緊咩。
ovl.es.en.gn.gerund-after-verbs.note: 喺 enjoy 同 mind 後面,英文要用 -ing:『I like cooking』。
ovl.es.en.gn.going-to.note: 呢個結構好直接對應:『I'm going to travel』——放心用,規律好清晰。
ovl.es.en.gn.had-to.note: 同其他過去問句一樣,did 帶住個時態:『did you have to wait?』,而肯定句就係『I had to wait.』
ovl.es.en.gn.have-got.note: 留意呢幾個講法英文轉咗做 be 動詞:肚餓、口渴、幾多歲全部用 am/is/are——『I AM hungry』、『I AM thirsty』、『I AM 20』。
ovl.es.en.gn.have-to.note: 『You don't have to come』意思係唔使嚟,唔係唔准嚟——當佢係自由,唔係禁止。
ovl.es.en.gn.how-much-many.note: 英文按可數性分開嚟問:數得到嘅嘢用 how many,數唔到嘅就用 how much。
ovl.es.en.gn.imperatives.note: 英文淨係一種祈使句,通用晒所有人;『please』就負責帶嚟嗰份禮貌。
ovl.es.en.gn.in-case-as-long-as.note: In case 加現在式動詞去準備一個可能性,as long as 就講一個條件:『take it in case it rains; stay as long as you like.』
ovl.es.en.gn.indef-pronouns.note: 英文淨係保留一個否定:『I didn't see anybody』,唔係『didn't see nobody』。
ovl.es.en.gn.indirect-questions.note: 喺一個有禮貌嘅框架入面,問句會變返做正常詞序——呢個係好易犯嘅錯:『could you tell me where the station is?』,唔係『where is the station?』。
ovl.es.en.gn.infinitive-after-verbs.note: 英文嘅 "to" 唔可以慳返:『I want to go』,to 一定要有。
ovl.es.en.gn.infinitive-purpose.note: 表達目的用『to + 動詞』,唔係『for + -ing』:『to learn』,唔係『for learning』。
ovl.es.en.gn.like-want-noun.note: 英文入面,鍾意嗰個人做主語:『I like tea』——冇 "me" 擺前面,一般性嘅嘢都唔加冠詞。
ovl.es.en.gn.make-let.note: Make 同 let 後面跟一個賓語,再跟一個唔加 to 嘅動詞:『they made me wait』,唔係『made me to wait』。
ovl.es.en.gn.might-may.note: 呢兩個字純粹表達唔肯定,同『識、能夠』嗰種 can 唔同意思。
ovl.es.en.gn.modal-deduction.note: 推測嗰陣,否定形式要用 can't be,唔係 mustn't be:『he must be tired』(肯定啦)、『she can't be tired』(唔可能)。
ovl.es.en.gn.much-many-alot.note: 英文將『好多』分成 much 同 many,肯定句入面 a lot of 就兩樣都啱用。
ovl.es.en.gn.must-mustnt.note: Mustn't 係禁止,同 don't have to(冇需要)係兩件事,唔好撈埋一齊。
ovl.es.en.gn.narrative-tenses.note: 呢個係你已經識嘅嗰種分工:事件用簡單過去式,背景就用過去進行式。
ovl.es.en.gn.obj-pron.note: 英文將賓語代名詞擺喺動詞後面:『I'll call you. I see her. Ask him.』
ovl.es.en.gn.passive-past.note: 呢個結構好直接對應:『was built in 1900』——was/were 加過去分詞。
ovl.es.en.gn.passive-present.note: 英文用 be 加分詞做被動式:『Spanish is spoken』——唔使講邊個講嘅。
ovl.es.en.gn.past-be.note: 英文嘅過去 be 動詞好簡單,淨係 was/were 兩個字,唔使諗其他分法。
ovl.es.en.gn.past-cont.note: 呢個結構好直接:was/were 加 -ing 動詞,講緊過去某一刻進行緊嘅事。
ovl.es.en.gn.past-perfect.note: 呢個結構好直接對應:had 加過去分詞,講兩件過去事入面較早嗰件。
ovl.es.en.gn.past-reg.note: -ed 呢個字尾有三種讀法:/t/(worked)、/d/(played)、/ɪd/(visited)。『visited』讀三個音節,『worked』就一個音節。
ovl.es.en.gn.past-simple-vs-cont.note: 俾人打斷嗰個較長動作用 was -ing,快嗰個動作就用簡單過去式:『I was cooking when he arrived.』
ovl.es.en.gn.perf-cont-vs-simple.note: 英文分得幾細:『I've painted it』講結果,『I've been painting』就講緊個過程。
ovl.es.en.gn.phrasal-separable.note: 跟返個規律就得:係『turn it on』,唔係『turn on it』,代名詞要擺喺中間。
ovl.es.en.gn.plural-irreg.note: 『People』喺英文係眾數:『people are friendly』,唔係『people is』。
ovl.es.en.gn.poss-adj.note: 英文將『佢嘅』分開講:his、her、its 同 their 各有各嘅字——睇返係邊個做擁有者,唔係睇返件嘢本身。
ovl.es.en.gn.poss-s.note: 英文嘅 's 將擁有者擺前面,嘢就擺後面:『Ana's dog』。
ovl.es.en.gn.prep-place.note: 英文將『喺』拆做 in、on 同 at 三種:『on the table』通常就係『喺枱面』。
ovl.es.en.gn.pres-cont-future.note: 現在進行式加一個時間,就可以講一個既定安排:『I'm meeting Ana at six.』
ovl.es.en.gn.pres-cont.note: 呢個結構好直接對應:be 加動詞-ing,信得過個規律。
ovl.es.en.gn.pres-perf-been-gone.note: 英文分得好清楚:gone 即係仲喺嗰度未返嚟,been 就係去咗又返咗嚟——『has gone to Lima』同『has been to Lima』唔同意思。
ovl.es.en.gn.pres-perf-cont.note: 英文用 have been -ing 表達『維持咗幾耐』:『I have been living here for two years.』
ovl.es.en.gn.pres-perf-exp.note: 一講到具體時間,英文就要轉用簡單過去式:『I have eaten at two』係錯嘅,一講出鐘數就要用 past simple。
ovl.es.en.gn.pres-perf-vs-past.note: 呢個係最易錯嘅位:一個時間講完咗——就算係『today at two』——都要用簡單過去式,唔可以用現在完成式。
ovl.es.en.gn.pres-perf-yet-already.note: Already 通常用喺肯定句,yet 就用喺問句同否定句。
ovl.es.en.gn.pres-simple-3sg.note: 呢個 -s 好容易漏低,但係一定要加:『she work』要改做『she works』。
ovl.es.en.gn.pres-simple-base.note: 英文動詞本身唔變,淨係靠主語代名詞分身份:I speak, you speak。
ovl.es.en.gn.pron-subject.note: 英文一定要有主語,唔可以慳返:講『I am Ana』,唔可以淨係講『am Ana』。
ovl.es.en.gn.question-tags.note: 呢個係 B1 入面最難嘅一個習慣:附加問句要反映返個助動詞,再將正負反轉,要慢慢練習先識。
ovl.es.en.gn.rel-object-omit.note: 英文可以自由咁將賓語關係詞省略:『the film we watched』就唔使加 "that"。
ovl.es.en.gn.rel-where-whose.note: 『Whose』喺英文係必須嘅,冇得慳:『the writer whose book won.』
ovl.es.en.gn.reported-commands.note: 轉述一個請求,英文用 tell 或者 ask 加一個 to-不定式:『she told me to wait.』
ovl.es.en.gn.reported-questions.note: 最經典嘅錯就係保留咗問句詞序:啱嘅講法係『she asked where I lived』,唔係『asked where did I live』。
ovl.es.en.gn.reported-statements.note: 時態推後嘅原理其實幾直接;真正嘅陷阱喺詞序——轉述句喺英文要變返做同肯定句一樣嘅詞序。
ovl.es.en.gn.say-vs-tell.note: Tell 後面即刻要跟一個人(tell me),say 就唔使(say that…);另外係『explain to me』,唔係『explain me』。
ovl.es.en.gn.should-advice.note: 呢個結構好直接:should 加一個唔加 to 嘅動詞:『you should rest.』
ovl.es.en.gn.simple-vs-cont.note: 英文分得幾清楚:『I eat』講習慣,『I am eating』就係即刻嗰刻——睇返啲時間詞嚟揀。
ovl.es.en.gn.so-because-although.note: 留意 because 唔等於 "because of",而且英文唔會將 although 同 but 一齊擺——揀一個講就夠。
ovl.es.en.gn.some-any.note: 英文肯定句鍾意用 some,問句同否定句就用 any:『Do you have any money?』
ovl.es.en.gn.superl-perf-ever.note: 英文會加多一個字『ever』:『the best I have ever seen.』
ovl.es.en.gn.sv-order.note: 英文一定要跟主語–動詞–賓語嘅順序,做動作嘅人要擺喺最前面,就算聽落好似重複都要跟。
ovl.es.en.gn.there-is-are.note: 『There』要跟返個數配合:一樣嘢用 there IS,兩樣或以上就用 there ARE。
ovl.es.en.gn.time-clauses.note: 喺 when 呢類字後面,英文淨係用現在式表達未來嘅意思:『when I arrive』,唔係『when I will arrive』。
ovl.es.en.gn.time-prep.note: 英文將時間介詞分做三種:at five、on Monday、in May——三個一齊記。
ovl.es.en.gn.time-telling.note: 講鐘數,英文用單數嘅『it's』,啱啱到鐘就加 o'clock:『It's three o'clock.』
ovl.es.en.gn.too-enough.note: Too 擺喺形容詞前面,enough 就擺喺形容詞後面、名詞前面:『warm enough, enough time.』
ovl.es.en.gn.too-to-so-that.note: 『Too tired to drive』同『so tired that I slept』——兩種講法都將個結果砌入形容詞入面。
ovl.es.en.gn.unless.note: Unless 後面淨係跟一個簡單現在式:『unless we leave.』
ovl.es.en.gn.used-to-vs-would.note: 講過去嘅狀態要用 used to,would 淨係啱用喺重複嘅動作。
ovl.es.en.gn.used-to.note: 『Used to』後面嘅動詞要保持原型:used to run,唔係 used to ran。
ovl.es.en.gn.verb-obj-inf.note: 英文用『賓語 + 不定式』表達呢種意思:『I want you to come.』
ovl.es.en.gn.verb-patterns-contrast.note: 句式會改變意思:『stop smoking』(戒咗佢)、『remember to do』(記得去做)。
ovl.es.en.gn.wh-quest-be.note: 喺日常英文問句入面,呢啲細字(好似 from)成日走去句尾:『Where are you from?』
ovl.es.en.gn.will-decide-offer.note: 即場決定嗰陣英文用 will:『I'll help you.』
ovl.es.en.gn.will-predict.note: 英文嘅 will 唔會因應人稱改變形狀:一個形式——will rain——就用晒所有人稱。
ovl.es.en.gn.will-vs-going-to.note: 呢度英文要求你揀返一個:即場決定用 will,已經諗好嘅計劃就用 going to。
ovl.es.en.gn.wish-past.note: Wish 後面用過去式,標示緊件事並唔係真:『I wish I had a garden.』
ovl.es.en.gn.would-like-offers.note: 『Would you like…?』先係有禮貌嘅提議方式,『I'd like…』就係溫柔啲嘅要求。
ovl.es.en.gn.would-like.note: 『I'd like』係最通用嘅有禮貌講法,喺咖啡店、商店、酒店都啱用。
